spec.description: CoreDNS serving metrics and the homedns blocklist plugin. Scoped to app.kubernetes.io/pod=homelab-dns-system-homedns, app.kubernetes.io/name=homedns.
Every query reaching the server, all zones and protocols.
spec.title: Queries/s

spec.description: Forwarded query outcomes plus upstream health. 'all upstreams down' above zero means the forward plugin found no healthy target.
spec.title: Upstream queries by result

spec.description: Fraction of checked queries answered NXDOMAIN. allowed_total counts queries that passed the check, not allowlist hits.
spec.title: Blocked share

spec.description: Blocked subtrees after dedup and pruning. max() across pods — each replica loads its own copy.
spec.title: Domains loaded

spec.description: 1 on any pod means it gave up waiting for a first list and is serving unfiltered. Worth an alert.
spec.title: Filtering

spec.description: A step down after a refresh means a source shrank or started failing. Replicas refresh independently, so they drift apart between reloads.
spec.title: Loaded domains per pod

spec.description: Sawtooth resetting on every refresh is healthy. A line that keeps climbing past 48h is a source that has silently stopped updating — the plugin keeps serving the last good copy, so nothing else looks wrong.
spec.title: Age of last successful fetch

spec.description: Failed fetches over the dashboard's time range. A failure is not immediately fatal — the last good copy stays loaded.
spec.title: Fetch failures in range

spec.description: End-to-end, including upstream. Blocked and cached answers pull this down.
spec.title: Latency p99

spec.description: Cumulative mean since process start, not a windowed rate: with refresh 24h a rate() over the dashboard range is empty almost all the time.
spec.title: Mean reload duration

spec.description: One row per configured URL. Entries are counted before dedup, so they add up to more than 'Domains loaded'.
spec.title: Blocklist sources

spec.description: Derived from hits/requests; coredns_cache_misses_total is deprecated upstream.
spec.title: Cache hit ratio

spec.description: Usually upstream trouble. NXDOMAIN is excluded — the blocklist makes that the normal case.
spec.title: SERVFAIL/s

spec.description: A/AAAA dominate on a LAN. A spike in one type is usually a single misbehaving client.
spec.title: Queries by type

spec.description: NXDOMAIN includes every blocked query — the blocklist answers NXDOMAIN by design.
spec.title: Responses by rcode

spec.description: Hits and misses as rates on the left axis; total cached entries on the right.
spec.title: Cache

spec.description: Time spent talking to the forward targets. DoT adds a handshake on a cold connection.
spec.title: Upstream latency p99 by server
